name: Elemental Conversion (Mythic)
body:
Elemental spells you cast are infused with raw chaos.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Conversion.

Benefits: You add 1/2 your mythic tier (minimum 1) to the number of times per day or per hour you can use Elemental Conversion. If the affected spell has not an instantaneous duration, you can expend one use of mythic power as an immediate action to randomly change its elemental energy every round.
